notes.title: Localization update for French, Russian and Polish
notes.content:
The latest update v1.1.2 adds support for French, Russian and Polish for all in-game text. Thanks a million to our amazing translators who put in the time to make it happen: Pierre-Yves Houlmont, Дмитрий Веснин (Dima), Michał Tosza and Tomasz Kontny.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677177/4754c1de359b76f46d8e2d53af2f2339caf1212c.png[/img]

notes.title: New Future Unfolding update based on your feedback
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26677177/c7374f993b42fcbb3cf692e5f1302cfbba94b427.jpg[/img]

Since our release, we have gotten a lot of feedback from you about Future Unfolding in reviews and comments. Thanks a lot for taking the time to write up your thoughts, it is very valuable to us!

We just released a big update for Future Unfolding that addresses a lot of your feedback. Here's what we changed in 1.1.0:
[list]
    [*]We redesigned the procedural world generation. We still have the same amount of content in the game, but a single playthrough will now be significantly shorter and feel less like a grind to play to the end. (Yes, there is an ending, if you haven't seen it yet. It's pretty cool.) That also means if you [b]want[/b] to replay the game a second or third time, you will see [b]more[/b] content that you previously haven't seen before.
    [*]Some of the puzzles could previously end up being very frustrating in some procedural configurations. We did a lot of polishing to the puzzles to fix that in the new version.
    [*]We did a lot of performance improvements for the PS4 version that we backported to Steam. You'll benefit from these optimisations if you have a lower-end CPU.
    [*]As a final thing we have polished some of the writing to keep it shorter overall and flow better with the game.
[/list]
We hope you like the new changes – let us know what you think in the comments or in your reviews!
